neighbours.label: ' a' in 'just a' before a small degree (little, bit, hair, touch), against 'just a' + plain noun and other ' a'
fire: Turn the volume down just a little before the baby wakes.
The coffee was just a bit too strong for me.
Raise the shelf just a hair so the door can close.
The jacket felt just a touch tight across the back.
Let the onions brown just a little longer in the pan.
The picture hangs just a bit crooked on that wall.
Her answer came just a little too quickly to be honest.
Slide the lamp just a tad closer to the sofa.
quiet: Turn the volume down a lot before the baby wakes.
The plumber is just a friend of my brother.
It was just a dream and nothing more.
The jacket had a tear across the back.
Let the onions brown in a pan with some butter.
The picture hangs on a nail on that wall.
Her answer came in a letter from the coast.
It is just a phone, so stop worrying.

notes: Output promotes ' touch', ' shade', ' hair'. German 'ein bisschen' also fired in probing.
